response.text:
I can do that, but this will delete data (a destructive action) so I need a couple quick confirmations and a way to identify the test rows before I proceed.

Please answer the following (or tell me which option to use):

1) Which sheet? — the sheet name, or "first sheet" if you want me to pick the first sheet.  
2) How to identify test rows? Pick one or give your own rule:
   - Delete rows where any cell contains the word "test" (case-insensitive).  
   - Delete rows where email/address contains "@example.com" or similar test domains.  
   - Delete rows created/modified before/after a date range (specify date).  
   - Delete rows with blank required fields (e.g., missing name or phone).  
   - I can inspect the sheet and show a preview of likely test rows and you confirm which to delete. (Recommended if you’re not sure.)

3) Backup: should I create a backup copy first? (recommended) If yes, tell me the backup name or I’ll name it "Leads_backup_before_cleanup_YYYYMMDD".

4) Preserve formulas/hidden columns? (I will preserve formulas by default; confirm if you want me to overwrite formulas.)

If you want me to decide automatically, say “Inspect and delete rows matching ‘contains test’ on sheet [name], create backup,” and I’ll inspect, show the matched rows, then delete after you confirm.
